name: trusted-ua-workspace
description: Pi Browser: Firefox add-on + Pi coding agent integration over Native Messaging and ACP

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @trusted-ua/protocol && npm run build -w trusted-user-agent
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trusted-ua/protocol && npm run build -w @trusted-ua/webext && npm run build -w trusted-user-agent && npm run build -w @trusted-ua/firefox && npm run build -w @trusted-ua/thunderbird
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trusted-ua/protocol && npm run test -w @trusted-ua/webext && npm run test -w trusted-user-agent && npm run test -w @trusted-ua/firefox && npm run test -w @trusted-ua/thunderbird && npm run test -w trusted-ua-tests
